description: Java class implementing centralized exception handling for a Spring Boot REST API, providing custom responses for specific exceptions and a generic handler.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring @ControllerAdvice class that handles exceptions globally across controllers, returning structured JSON responses.

methods.name: baseBody
methods.description: Creates a standardized response body with timestamp, status, error, and message.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles ResourceNotFoundException, returning a 404 response with a custom message.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation exceptions, returning a 400 response with validation errors detailed.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions, returning a 500 internal server error response.
